changes.title: Google Classroom Real-Time Assignment Status Badges
changes.description: Integrated real-time submission tracking (studentSubmissions API) to display bottom-right status indicators on all To-Do assignments for Missing (Red), Assigned (Blue), Turned in (Green), and Returned/Graded (Purple) across light, dark, and gray themes.

changes.title: To-Do Two-Group Vertical Task Arrangement
changes.description: Separated active/pending assignments from completed ones so that pending assignments stay clearly in view at the top, while turned-in assignments are neatly grouped below, each sorted in ascending order of due dates.

changes.title: Automatic Pending Tasks Completion Synchronization
changes.description: Whenever you sign into Google Classroom or open the Classroom window, turned-in or graded assignments automatically check the corresponding tasks in your personal Pending Tasks list in Firestore.

changes.title: Two-Way Task Sync with In-Place Updates
changes.description: Clicking the Sync button in Classroom To-Do now adds new assignments and automatically updates existing tasks if a teacher modifies deadlines, titles, or descriptions in Google Classroom.

changes.title: Changelog Modal Theme Colors & Vivid Badges
changes.description: Enhanced font brightness and contrast in dark and gray modes for changelog descriptions, dates, and subtitle texts. Added bright, high-contrast category badges for New Feature, Fix & Enhancement, Security, and Major updates.

changes.title: Calendar Desktop Minimum Width & Cell Sizing
changes.description: Enforced an 820px minimum width on the desktop calendar modal content and 780px on the calendar grid with horizontal overflow support, preventing task items and course names from being squeezed on compact displays.

changes.title: Protruding Floating Close Button & Unclipped Corner
changes.description: Redesigned the calendar modal close button to float over the top-right corner with 360-degree rotation and scale micro-interactions. Eliminated container corner clipping by enforcing visible overflow and elevated z-index.

changes.title: Theme-Adaptive Month & Year Dropdown Chevrons
changes.description: Replaced harsh red dropdown arrows with sleek, modern stroke chevrons tuned to match active Light, Dark (lime green), and Gray (lavender/silver) themes.

changes.title: Hidden Scrollbars Across Calendar Window
changes.description: Applied cross-browser scrollbar hiding across the calendar grid, weekly views, mobile date lists, and task detail modals while retaining full smooth scrolling via touch, mouse wheel, and trackpad.

changes.title: Version Update & What's New Modal
changes.description: Interactive changelog modal that automatically notifies users whenever a new service worker version is deployed, loading update history directly from changes.json with direct links to full documentation.

changes.title: Persistent Task Type Filters & Re-clickable Controls
changes.description: Task list filters (Assignment, Homework, Exam, Project, Presentation, Other) remain strictly active when checking/unchecking tasks or deleting entries. Filter buttons are re-clickable to instantly refresh the filtered view.

changes.title: Dynamic Department & Metadata Options Architecture
changes.description: Resolved issue where new departments added in Firestore did not reflect on the frontend. Added server-priority fetching, multi-structure document support, dynamic event department selectors, and dropdown state preservation.

changes.title: Smaller Desktop Display Responsiveness (1366x768px)
changes.description: Added optimized typography, spacing, card dimensions, and UI scaling specifically tuned for compact desktop displays and standard 1366x768 laptop screens.

changes.title: Dedicated Semester Notice Dismissal Flag
changes.description: Semester auto-promotion notice dismissal is now persisted to the user profile in Firestore database (semesterNoticeDismissedCycle), keeping the banner dismissed across multiple logins until the next promotion cycle.

changes.title: Google Classroom Materials Tab
changes.description: Added Materials view toggle alongside To-Do and Notices to view all posted course materials across active courses, powered by Google Classroom courseWorkMaterials API.

changes.title: Client JSON Template Caching & Incremental Sync
changes.description: Structured JSON template caching for offline access across token expirations, with fingerprinting to skip unchanged items during background sync.

changes.title: Hover Expand Dropdown & Attachment Pills
changes.description: Interactive hover expand button on Classroom list items rendering Google Drive files, YouTube videos, and forms as clickable pills.

changes.title: Quick Links Dropdown & Calendar View Prominence
changes.description: Replaced resource links grid with a compact Quick Links dropdown header button and elevated Calendar View button prominence on desktop.

changes.title: Font Awesome v5/v6/v7 Cross-Version Support
changes.description: Upgraded Font Awesome to v6.7.2 with full cross-version syntax support across all themes.

changes.title: DOM Layout Card Breakdown & Expand Button Alignment
changes.description: Prevented nested links in announcement bodies from splitting card layouts and pinned expand chevrons to top-right.

changes.title: Google Classroom Session Persistence
changes.description: Preserves connected status across 1-hour access token expirations with silent token renewal and cached fallback.

changes.title: Unified Classroom Header Sign Out Button
changes.description: Single pill-styled Sign Out button added to top window title headers, removing duplicate buttons.

changes.title: Semester Auto-Promotion Cycle Tracking
changes.description: Banner dismissal tracked per semester cycle in July and January.

changes.title: Environment Variable Migration
changes.description: Migrated standard Firebase API keys inside firebase-config.js to environment variables with strict HTTP referrers restriction.

changes.title: Enhanced Markdown & Code Blocks
changes.description: Global support for fenced code blocks, preformatted tags, and safe HTML entities across tasks, events, notices, and notes.

changes.title: Note PDF Export Dark Mode Contrast
changes.description: Forced white background and black text repainting during PDF generation to ensure perfect readability in dark themes.

changes.title: Classroom Drop-in Refresh
changes.description: Manual refresh button to clear cached items and fetch fresh assignments and announcements on demand.

changes.title: PWA Offline View Loading & Deferred Login
changes.description: Deferred Google Classroom silent auth to prevent login flash on startup. Improved offline banner mobile layout.

changes.title: Task Card Layout & Title Overlap Fix
changes.description: Optimized description width below checkboxes and fixed title wrap for long task headings.

changes.title: Note PDF Export & Client-Side ZIP Compression
changes.description: Integrated html2pdf.js for note exports and JSZip for automatic client-side compression of unsupported file types.

changes.title: Urgent Deadline Visibility & Preloader Synchronization
changes.description: High-contrast urgent deadline text in dark mode and synchronized dashboard revealing after full data load.

changes.title: Gray Mode Monochromatic Theme
changes.description: Sleek low-strain monochromatic theme set as system dark mode default across Classroom, Timeline, and Dashboards.

changes.title: Overdue Task Highlights
changes.description: Redesigned overdue task cards for all dark themes to guarantee clarity without harsh contrast.

changes.title: Classroom Sync to Tasks
changes.description: One-click synchronization of active Google Classroom assignments into b1t-Sched tasks for Admins and CRs with duplicate prevention.

changes.title: Student Search & Semester Auto-Promotion
changes.description: Real-time user search bar in User Management and automatic semester advancement in July and January with cooldown protection.

changes.title: Mobile Monthly Calendar View
changes.description: Compact date grid with week numbers, dot indicators, and tappable date task panels.

changes.title: Activity Timeline Heatmap & Live User Counter
changes.description: Interactive productivity heatmap, weekly bar charts, and live active user count.

changes.title: Progressive Web App (PWA) & Calendar View
changes.description: Full offline support, Service Worker caching, install prompt management, and desktop monthly calendar view.

changes.title: Complete Redesign as SPA with Firebase
changes.description: Rebuilt from ground up as a Single Page Application with Firebase Authentication, Firestore database, and role-based access control.
